words.ex: Running late for the bus, Oydin scribbled a message on the back of a receipt so messily that her brother could hardly read it.
Her emails to old classmates are long and chatty, full of jokes and news about the neighbours.
Keep a small notebook by your bed so you can quickly jot down any ideas that come to you in the night before they slip away.
The secretary made a note of every question the parents raised so the head teacher could answer them later.
During the endless phone call, Sherzod doodled little stars and spirals all over the margins of his notebook.
Our teacher asked us to copy out the poem by hand, word for word, in our neatest handwriting.
Nigora spent the evening drafting a letter of complaint to the bus company, knowing she would rewrite it the next day.
Now that the experiments are over, Iroda is writing up her results, turning months of rough notes into the full, finished chapters of her thesis.
Since learning to touch-type, Ulugbek keeps his eyes on the screen and never glances down at the keys.
The finished typescript, all four hundred pages of it, sat on the editor's desk for months before anyone at the publishing house read it.
Could you run off twenty copies of the timetable before the meeting starts?
The table looked fine on screen, but the columns came out crooked on paper until Lobar formatted the page properly, with equal margins and spacing.
Rather than retyping the whole list, just copy and paste it from the email into your report.
In our textbook every key term is printed in bold, so the thick dark letters jump out from the rest of the page.
Titles of books and films are often written in italics, with the letters sloping slightly to the right.
The poster looked messy because Dilfuza had used five different fonts, including one that looked like handwriting.
In Asal's essay the first line of a new paragraph was never indented, so the page looked like one solid block and it was hard to see where each paragraph began.
On the café menu, dishes marked with an asterisk are suitable for vegetarians; the little star is explained at the bottom.
Put the main advantages as short bullet points so the reader can scan them quickly.
In many dictionaries, the pronunciation of a word is given between square brackets, like this: [kæt].
In some programming languages, lines of code are grouped together inside curly brackets, { and }.
When you use a writer's exact words in your essay, put them between quotation marks and name the source.
The password must contain at least one letter in upper case, for example a capital A or B.
My password was rejected because I had typed every letter in lower case instead of starting with a capital.
On the parcel label, Temur wrote the address in large block capitals, each letter separate and clear, so the courier couldn't misread it.
Footnote numbers in this book appear in superscript, as tiny figures raised above the line at the end of a sentence.
The book is called 'Green Cities', and its subtitle, 'Designing for a Hotter Planet', explains what it is really about.
In this exercise, a hint is given after each sentence in round brackets, like this: (two words).
Each chapter heading in the travel guide names a different region, so you can find the section you need quickly.
The chapter is long, but each short section inside it starts with its own sub-heading, so it is easy to find your place.
The lecturer speaks so fast that nobody manages to write down everything she says.
Ozoda handed in a rough draft of her essay, full of crossings-out, and her tutor suggested changes before the final version.
Instead of having the same paragraph twice, cut and paste it so that it moves to the top of the page.
Key facts are printed in a shaded box with a pale grey background, so you can find them quickly.
Ravshan increased the font size on his phone so that he could read messages without his glasses.
The designer created a new typeface for the city's street signs, with clear, rounded letters.
In British schools, children learn to put the exact words a character says in inverted commas.

In web code, every tag is written between angle brackets, like this:

.
Please fill in your surname in capitals, so that every letter is easy to read.
Some modern poets write their whole poems in small letters, without a single capital.
The author changed the title of her novel three times before choosing 'Salt and Silk' for the front cover.
Text messages on old mobile phones were limited to 160 characters, so people invented short forms like 'gr8'.
